# Assignment Design Guide

Choose one core concept and two to four progressive tasks. Start with a small confidence-building task, then add complexity or a stretch goal. State measurable requirements; avoid giving the complete solution in starter code.

Use starter code when scaffolding or function signatures matter. Use synthetic datasets, never student records or secrets.

- Beginner: variables, loops, conditionals, strings.
- Intermediate: functions, collections, file I/O, classes.
- Advanced: HTTP APIs, testing, data analysis.

For APIs, teach local examples and test status codes; do not require public hosting or paid services.
